notes.title: Price Drop!
notes.content: While our games are on sale right now, the regular price of Suki's Spooky Romance has been lowered forever to match the regular price of Unrested Development. Both games are now $1.99 U.S. all the time, but they are a steal at the sale price of 60% off!

notes.title: Suki's Spooky Romance
notes.content:
Part two in the story has been out for about a week now, and it's part of the Steam Summer Sale.

Buy it alone, or as part of The Whole Cow bundle.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Catgirls!
notes.content:
It's May and Suki's game, part two in the trilogy, is almost here.

Suki's Spooky Romance--a slight name change from the working title--should be out for sale this month.  You can find the, "Coming Soon," page here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/847940/Sukis_Spooky_Romance/

Part two changes up the game play a bit and offers a whole new kind of adventure.  You also get four catgirls, and that means four times the waifu fun.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: UPDATE!
notes.content:
Just a few more tweeks to the game.  Minor glitches patched.  Suki's got a little more scratch in her claws.  A couple of tough critters were scaled down.

See you in part two, Suki's Scary Romance, just a few months from now.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: New Year; New Price
notes.content:
It's 2018,  and we're dropping the price on Unrested Development.  In anticipation of the next release, UD will now go for just $1.99 US.

And part two of the trilogy, Suki's Scary Romance, will come in at just 2.99.  You'll get a new story, longer game, and plenty of catgirls for less than three bucks!

The release date isn't set, but we'll keep you posted.  Until then, happy gaming.

notes.title: Four Catgirls and Romance, Too!
notes.content:
Before the conclusion of Unrested Development gets released later this year, we have a nice interlude for all the catgirl fans.

Suki becomes a catgirl again in her own game!

Her mission:  Help three other catgirls rescue their master, a great wizard, who will make Suki a catgirl forever.  Then, she can win the heart of Jacob!

The events in this upcoming game happen directly between Unrested Development and its sequel, Uneasy Pieces.

Stay tuned for Suki's Scary Romance!

notes.title: Rock Cow Gives Back
notes.content:
Rock Cow Productions has found a worthy charity, and throughout 2018, a portion of each game sale will go towards a needy family.  You can read about them on our new Facebook page.  We've posted a link to their Go Fund Me page there.

Now you can have a little fun and help others, too!

Rock Cow Productions also pledges a portion of this year's new release sales.  Keep an eye out for some new titles coming soon!

Here's our Facebook page.  You can give it a Like while you are there!

https://www.facebook.com/RockCowProductions/

notes.title: UD Update!
notes.content:
A new build has gone out today, and it's looking like the final set of tweeks for Unrested Development.  Gave Saves shouldn't be harmed by this rollout.

Hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
An update went out late this evening.  It contains some minor tweeks and bug fixes.  Thanks to all for playing and reporting.

We're sorry for any down time during the update.  If there is any problem getting the patch, Steam has some tips which include uninstalling, signing out, and returning to reinstall a game.  They also suggest clearing the download cache.

Enjoy!

notes.title: What Lies Ahead
notes.content:
2018 will be seeing the much bigger sequel to Unrested Development which will continue the story.

Also, more fun, drama, and perhaps even a catgirl or two in some upcoming Visual Novel games!

A Clicker/Idle game?  Perhaps.  And much more!  We'll keep you up to date, right here.
